# Passport photo layout editor

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/passport-photo/

Position a photo inside an editable millimetre crop and arrange copies on A4, Letter or a small photo sheet.

## How to use it

1. Choose a clear, supported image from your device.
2. Adjust the image settings and run the tool.
3. Inspect the preview, then download or copy the result.

## Example

Set a 35 × 45 mm crop, adjust the framing and create a sheet at 300 pixels per inch.

## Limits and checks

Dimensions alone do not establish passport or visa compliance. Check the issuing authority’s current background, face, expression and printing requirements.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
